messages:
sam: Hey team — opened a Terraform PR that touches the Karpenter provisioner, cluster-autoscaler autoscalingGroups, and a couple of HPAs for the worker services. Need a quick review, especially around scaleDown delays and secret rotation.

olivia: link to PR?

sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342 : I'm changing provisioner TTLSecondsUntilExpired from 300 to 120 and adding a `consolidation: disabled` patch to avoid pod churn for short-lived batch jobs.

alex: quick q — are those batch jobs behind an HPA or just Karpenter-scheduled? If HPA targets CPU it's fine, but if HPA min=0 + provisioner TTL low we might see cold starts.

sam: HPA exists for batch-dispatcher (minReplicas: 0, maxReplicas: 20, metrics cpu). The idea was to let Karpenter scale nodes down faster to save cost.

chandra: concern: when node drains quickly we can lose KV-cache-backed workers. Could we set podDisruptionBudget or use graceful shutdown hooks? Also secret rotation: PR moves kms_key_id into a data resource; that could break in private deploys.

sam: good point — added a PDB with minAvailable: 1 for the dispatcher. Also added preStop hook.

sam:
```yaml
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh","-c","sleep 10 && /usr/local/bin/flush-cache"]
```

chandra: terraform snippet looks like this — I think the secrets wiring needs a null_resource to trigger new pods on secret change.

chandra:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_secret" "worker-config" {
  metadata { name = "worker-config" }
  data = { config = base64encode(file("./config.json")) }
}
resource "null_resource" "restart_on_secret_change" {
  triggers = { digest = md5(kubernetes_secret.worker-config.data["config"]) }
}
```

olivia: runbook check — if Karpenter TTL lowered, what's the expected node churn? ops SLO? We should ensure Dedicated tier unaffected.

sam: expected churn: +15% node turnover on peak; Dedicated pools are excluded via labels. The provisioner now only matches label `karpenter.k8s.aws/provisioner-name = batch-provisioner`.

infra-bot: CI: terraform fmt OK. Plan: 8 to add, 6 to change, 2 to destroy. (job id: infra-plan-7821)

deploy-bot: smoke tests passed for staging after applying PR on staging cluster :white_check_mark:

alex: LGTM aside from one nit — can we document the reasoning in the PR body re: TTL and PDB so future reviewers don't revert?

sam: yep will add. Thanks all :heart:

olivia: I'll pair-review later today. If anyone sees flapping on staging ping #eng-oncall.

sam: thanks! I'll wait for docs update and then merge after green CI"
